# Permission request to a textbook publisher (template)

Status: draft template. It has not been sent. Fill in the bracketed parts. Send it on paper or by email from the project owner, and keep the written reply. Only a written reply changes a status in `docs/SOURCE_PERMISSION_REGISTER.md`.

---

To: [Name and title], [Publisher, for example Gujarat State Board of School Textbooks]

From: DIVYESH BAMBHANIYA, GRANTH-AI (FOUNDER & PROJECT DEVELOPER: DIVYESH BAMBHANIYA). [Address, email, phone]

Date: [date]

Subject: Request for written permission to use [title, standard, subject, medium, edition/year] in GRANTH-AI

GRANTH-AI is a non-commercial study aid for Gujarati-medium students. A student selects a textbook and asks a question. The app shows the textbook's own sentences that answer it, with the page number, or says that the book does not contain the answer. It is a demo today and contains only material we wrote ourselves.

We ask for permission for each use below. Please mark each one Yes, No or Yes with conditions.

| # | Use | What it means in practice | Yes / No / Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Digital storage | Keeping a copy of the textbook PDF on our server | |
| 2 | Text extraction | Reading the text out of the PDF by program | |
| 3 | OCR | Recognising text from scanned pages where the PDF has no text layer | |
| 4 | Search indexing | Building a search index over the text | |
| 5 | AI question answering | Selecting sentences from the book to answer a student's question. By default no text is sent to any outside AI service. | |
| 6 | Short quotations | Showing one to a few sentences word for word as the answer | |
| 7 | Page citations | Showing chapter, section and page number, and the page image for the cited page | |
| 8 | Offline access | Letting a student save the book's text on their own device for use without internet | |
| 9 | Distribution | Making the app, with this content, available to [schools / the public] | |
| 10 | User access | Who may use it: [students of named schools / any student], free of charge | |
| 11 | Retention and deletion | We keep the content until you withdraw permission; we delete all copies within [14] days of a written request | |

We will: show your name, the title and the edition on every answer; not change the text; not charge students; not use the text to train any AI model; remove the content on request.

Please tell us: the licence or terms that apply; any attribution wording you require; the period of the permission; whether it covers future editions; a contact for questions.

IDEA CONTRIBUTOR: BHAVESHBHAI SOLANKI

FOUNDER & PROJECT DEVELOPER: DIVYESH BAMBHANIYA

Signature: ____________
